en.title: UK 2026 Inflation Range Probability Rises
en.summary: The probability of UK 2026 inflation settling between 3.5% and 3.9% increased significantly by 12.5% to 40%. This surge was primarily driven by recent ONS data showing annual earnings growth at 3.9%, aligning with the target range's upper bound.
drivers: ONS reports 3.9% annual earnings growth.
State pension likely to rise by 3.9%.
Earnings growth slowed from 4.2% to 3.9%.
en.why_matters: This movement indicates market confidence in the Bank of England's ability to guide inflation towards a stable, albeit above-target, level by 2026. It impacts future monetary policy decisions and economic stability.
en.bull_case: Persistent wage growth at 3.9% and inflation-linked pension increases suggest underlying price pressures will keep 2026 inflation within the 3.5%-3.9% range.
en.bear_case: Public inflation expectations at 3.2% and low food inflation indicate stronger disinflationary forces, likely pushing 2026 inflation below 3.5%.
